messages.author: a24029eaff1e58bd
messages.subject: Arrange Order of the legend parameter
parts:
qplot(Drug_A, Drug_B, data=dsmall, colour = p_value, size = p_value)
last_plot() + scale_size_manual (values = c(0.0001,12,10,4,8))
last_plot() + opts(axis.title.x = theme_blank(),
axis.title.y = theme_blank())
last_plot() + opts(axis.text.x = theme_blank(),
axis.text.y = theme_blank())
axis.ticks = theme_blank()
last_plot() + opts(axis.ticks = theme_blank())

I used the above script to create a ggplot of Drug_A and Drug_B.
I removed the labels and also the ticks from the plot.
Now the problem is that the plot is done but the order of the p-value
displayed in the plot in not proper.
It should be like
0.000001 to 0.00001
0.0001 to 0.001
0.01 to 0.05.
The order is not how in the above expected form, please let me know a
way to customize the order.
And also i would like to add a title to the x-axis, it tried different
ways but nothing is working fine
